notes.title: Have You Herd? - Demo Live, Couch Co-Op Fest Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hiya folks!

From all of us at Tideturners, we're so excited to to say that our demo is now [b]LIVE[/b] and we will be a part of Steam's Couch Co-Op Fest!

We've gone through ups and downs since the beginning of our development in 2022, but we have persevered and I think will show it ;)

This game has been a true labor of love, and we are so thankful for every single set of hands that have poured their all into this game.

Cheers to what we've accomplished, and what's more to come! HERD UP!

Yours truly, 
Tideturners

P.S.: We are aware of a few bugs that may occur. Usually fully exiting the game and starting it back up should fix any weirdness. It is a demo after all!
